{{Quote|Come back soon, I'll be waiting!|Ackmena|<ref name="hs" />}}
'''Ackmena''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was the nightshift [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. She was a favorite amongst the patrons there, as she was more approachable than the daytime bartender, [[Wuher/Legends|Wuher]]. Ackmena, realizing this, requested better hours from her employer, [[Chalmun/Legends|Chalmun]], but the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] initially refused, sparking a confrontation between the two that lasted for [[Standard month/Legends|months]]. Even though Ackmena was better liked than Wuher, during her shifts she was aided by [[Tork]], a bouncer. As entertainment, she would occasionally sing to her patrons.

One [[Standard day/Legends|night]], after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Ackmena had to fend off the advances of the amorous [[Krelman]]. Later that night, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] imposed a curfew on all residents of the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]]. Ackmena tried to get her patrons to leave, but was initially unsuccessful, until she broke into song. She later turned her amateur singing into profit, teaming up with fellow entertainer [[Cebann Veekan]]. Together, the two of them formed an acting troupe, and enjoyed success with a production based on the life of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] hero, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. By the year [[44 ABY]], Ackmena had joined [[Freedom Flight]], an organization dedicated to freeing [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Biography==
===Pre-Yavin career===
{{Quote|Well, I'm certainly not going to get rich with customers like you. I thought I taught you to drink faster than that. Well, at least you're steady. Oh, come on now. Drink up, there's plenty more where that came from.|Ackmena|<ref name="hs" />}}
[[File:Ackmenas_patrons.jpg|thumb|left|270px|Ackmena with her patrons in Chalmun's Cantina.]]
Ackmena was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="db" /> in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> who was born between approximately [[45 BBY/Legends|45 BBY]] and [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]].<ref name="dob" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="hs" /> she<ref name="db" /> worked as the [[Standard day/Legends|nighttime]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in the city of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="cswe">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> She would often bid her patrons farewell with the words "Come back soon, I'll be waiting." A [[Sosio Kakra|diminutive being]] aided her in her bartending tasks,<ref name="hs" /> while the tall [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Tork]] served as a bouncer.<ref name="rr">{{InsiderCite|91|Refresher Reading}}</ref> Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="iswt">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="nec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> she requested better hours from [[Chalmun/Legends|Chalmun]], the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina's]] owner.<ref name="iswt" /> In doing so, she cited her popularity over [[Wuher/Legends|Wuher]], the daytime bartender, but Chalmun did not agree, resulting in a conflict between the bartender and her [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] employer that lasted [[Standard month/Legends|months]].<ref name="db" />

===Broadcast blues===
{{Quote|Listen, Krelman, you're kind and sweet and terribly attractive, but if you're saying what I think you're saying you felt you meant I thought you needed to hear, then I just have one thing to say: I did not.|Ackmena|<ref name="hs" />}}
Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Ackmena was tending the bar when footage was taken inside the cantina by the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Council]], and broadcast live to other [[Star system/Legends|systems]], including the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]]. As Tork ejected a [[Cyceyed|patron]] from the cantina, Ackmena berated the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Zutmore]] for consuming his beverage too slowly, and suggested that he quicken his pace if he wanted to stay. She then went on to encourage [[Kelbo]], a [[Nikto/Legends|M'shento'su'Nikto]] who was reluctant to drink. Soon enough, she was approached by [[Krelman]], who wanted to talk with her rather than drink. He arbitrarily ordered a drink, which Ackmena served, but she chose not to converse with the man&mdash;she had other customers waiting.<ref name="hs" />

[[File:Cantinaackmena.jpg|thumb|right|270px|Ackema and Krelman]]
Ackmena served the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Deneb Both]] next, but was then summoned back by Krelman, who had finished his drink and placed a [[Unidentified flower (Krelman)|flower]] in his cup for the bartender. Ackmena was flattered, and Krelman explained that he had been in the cantina previously. He had interpreted her parting words of "Come back soon, I'll be waiting," as a personal, unique message to him, and he now believed that he was meant to be with her. Krelman ventured behind the bar, and embraced Ackmena, but she responded by explaining that he had misinterpreted her words. The bartender was able to persuade Krelman to return to his seat by giving him a complimentary drink, but still the man would not accept the fact that she was not interested in him. As another one of her patrons, [[Pons Limbic/Legends|Pons Limbic]], departed, she uttered her usual farewell. Realizing his folly, Krelman ceased his advances towards Ackmena.<ref name="hs" />

===Curfew===
{{Quote|Gentlemen, gentlemen. I don't know how to tell you this, but I guess the wall screen said it all. We're closed.|Ackmena attempts to close the cantina|<ref name="hs" />}}
Shortly thereafter, an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] message was displayed on the cantina's [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]]&mdash;due to subversive activities, a curfew was to be placed on the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]], effective immediately. As a result, all of Ackmena's patrons were required by law to return to their homes, which was not an uncommon occurrence. Acting without delay, the bartender approached [[Figrin D'an/Legends|Barbarine]] and the [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Modal Nodes]], a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] band playing in the cantina that night. She asked Barbarine and his band to depart, perhaps forever, but this caused a considerable amount of discontent amongst both the [[Musician/Legends|musicians]] and the patrons. Relenting, Ackmena offered the band a round of complimentary drinks before departing, and had Tork collect their orders.<ref name="hs" />

[[File:Solomahal3.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Ackmena persuading Solomahal to leave the cantina]]
Ackmena continued her attempts to get her customers to depart, however. She approached a pair of [[Duro/Legends|Duros]] who were chatting animatedly and asked them politely to leave, but they ignored her. Growing frustrated, she began yelling, urging the cantina patrons to return to their homes, but they reacted violently by throwing things at her. Ackmena was outraged, but she stopped Tork from responding in kind. She quietly asked Zutmore and Kelbo to leave, citing the times in the past that she had loaned them [[Currency/Legends|money]], but even they ignored her. Desperate for some support, she turned to the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bludlow/Legends|Bludlow]], and the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Thorp]]&mdash;they offered her the same response as the others. As a last-ditch effort, she approached the [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillian]] [[Solomahal/Legends|Solomahal]], but unlike the others, had never encountered him before in the cantina.<ref name="hs" />

The situation reached fever pitch when the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Kardue'sai'Malloc/Legends|Kardue'sai'Malloc]]<ref name="Star Wars Blog">{{SW|url=news/the-star-wars-holiday-special-cantina-we-may-not-thrive-friend-but-we-survive-friend|text=''The Star Wars Holiday Special'' Cantina: Who's Who|int=The Star Wars Holiday Special Cantina: Who's Who|nolive=1}}</ref> entered the bar, and reacted to Ackmena's insistence that they were closed by drawing a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. The bartender urged Tork to stand down, and the Devaronian took a seat. Thorp then demanded another drink, banging his empty glass on the table. He was soon joined by the other patrons in his protest. Realizing that she could not control the situation, Ackmena conceded, and offered everyone in the cantina one more drink, compliments of the bar. They all agreed, and as Ackmena began serving the drinks, she broke, unbidden, into a rendition of "[[Goodnight, But Not Goodbye/Legends|Goodnight, But Not Goodbye]]," complemented by the Modal Nodes.<ref name="hs" />

[[File:Saynotoackmena.jpg|thumb|right|230px|Bludlow and Sakiyan refuse to leave]]
As Ackmena sang her song, the patrons gradually began to depart. When the [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] [[Caldera Righim]] left, Ackmena was approached by the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Teak Sidbam/Legends|Teak Sidbam]], who began to dance with her. Bludlow decided to join in, as did the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Myhr Rho]]. Rho, however, grew overly amorous, and had to be ejected by Tork. While some of the customers had left, there were a significant number still seated, and so Ackmena took a new approach. She led a march around the cantina in time with the [[Music/Legends|music]], urging the customers to follow her. They did so, and she was able to lead them straight out the door, aided by Tork. When they were all gone, she bade goodbye to Barbarine and his band, Tork, and her diminutive assistant, before closing the doors to Chalmun's Cantina. When she turned back to the bar, Krelman was there, waiting with his flower. Approaching him, she accepted the flower, just as the Imperial broadcast of their activities stopped.<ref name="hs" />

===The entertainer===
{{Quote|Well, I have customers to attend to, and my little Chadra-Fan waitress tends to get her hands full after about twenty minutes left on her own. Come back day after tomorrow and I'll have that shipment ready for you.|Ackmena, speaking in code about a group of escaped slaves|<ref name="Allies" />}}
At some stage, Ackmena teamed up with [[Cebann Veekan]], a [[Hamadryas]] who shared her theatrical skill. They eventually formed their own [[Ackmena-Veekan acting troupe|troupe]], and Chalmun allowed them to perform at the cantina, provided they turned a profit.<ref name="cvdb">{{DB|character|cebannveekan|Veekan, Cebann}}</ref> The two of them would perform together, enjoying moderate success.<ref name="db" /> Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="cswe" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="nec" /> she and Veekan made a stage hit out of the life-story of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], a Tatooine native who became a hero in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="cswe" /> Their production inspired Myhr Rho, a regular at the cantina, to start up a [[Skywalker Tour|tour]] of Tatooine locations tied to Skywalker's exploits.<ref name="mrdb">{{DB|character|myhrrho|Rho, Myhr}}</ref> Eventually, Ackmena and Veekan enjoyed enough success to move their production from Chalmun's Cantina to a more suitable venue.<ref name="db" />

After achieving fame with her singing and becoming a Tatooine celebrity of sorts, Ackmena would nevertheless return to Chalmun's and tend the bar during the nightshift.<ref name="Allies" /> By [[44 ABY]],<ref name="terc">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> she had joined [[Freedom Flight]], an organization dedicated to freeing [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. She met with the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] known as [[Blink]], another member of the organization, in the cantina during one of her shifts to discuss a shipment of slaves that would be leaving the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and earning their freedom. The conversation was watched by a male Human who was soon after [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Blink and the young slave [[Kitaya Shuul]]. Blink then sent Shuul to inform Ackmena that the shipment would be delayed.<ref name="Allies" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|What'll it be?''"<br />"''Hello, Ackmena.''"<br />"''Okay, we'll do it your way. Hello. Now we'll do it my way. What'll it be?''"<br />"''Can we talk?''"<br />"''Well, of course we can talk. We are talking. You're not ordering. I'm not pouring. We are not drinking. We are talking.|Ackmena and Krelman|<ref name="hs" />}}
[[File:Cantina_ackmena_krelman_cebann.png|thumb|left|260px|Ackema tends bar]]
1.82 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="db" /> with [[Color/Legends|gray]] hair,<ref name="hs" /> Brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]],<ref name="sl" /> and a light complexion,<ref name="hs" /> Ackmena was better respected by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] than Chalmun's daytime bartender, Wuher, who was considered surly and unapproachable.<ref name="cswe" /> She was cheerful, if gruff, and was admired by many of the cantina's regulars. While in her eighties, she was a member of Freedom Flight, an organization that directed its efforts towards freeing slaves throughout the galaxy.<ref name="Allies" /> In addition to her other skills, Ackmena was considered an expert in the mixing of beverages.<ref name="unl">{{InsiderCite|100|Best of StarWars.com}}</ref>

During the Imperial broadcast, Ackmena would constantly encourage her patrons to purchase and consume more of her drinks, and would not tolerate loitering. She would not stop and chat idly with her patrons, as she had no desire to leave customers waiting. When Krelman insisted on engaging her in a conversation, she would begin performing other tasks, only paying cursory attention. She ignored him until he came into physical contact with her. When the Imperial curfew was issued, Ackmena did not question the orders, but was dissatisfied with them. Nevertheless, she acted quickly on the decree, and ushered her patrons home, although she was not initially successful. She was loathe to have Tork eject patrons, even when threatened with a deadly weapon. Ackmena tried a variety of non-violent methods when trying to get her customers to leave, before resorting to singing.<ref name="hs" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It was a wonderful time, but I had no idea it was even a part of the whole ''Star Wars'' thing. I just remember singing to a bunch of people with funny heads.|Bea Arthur|<ref name="iha">{{InsiderCite|106|I Have a Bad Feeling About This!}}</ref>}}
[[File:AckmenaInsider.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Pablo Hidalgo's drawing of a hypothetical ''Unleashed'' figure of Ackmena]]
The character of Ackmena was created for ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'', a television special that aired in [[1978]]. She was played by [[Bea Arthur]], who was best-known at the time for her portrayal of the title character in the television series [[Wikipedia:Maude (TV series)|''Maude'']]. Arthur was friends with<ref name="iha" /> [[Ken Welch|Ken]] and [[Mitzie Welch]],<ref name="Comedy Hour 2">{{WebCite|url=https://www.vanityfair.com/magazine/2008/12/star_wars_special200812?currentPage=2|text=The Han Solo Comedy Hour! (page 2 of 3)|archivedate=20110531032415}}</ref> the composers who had written the lyrics to the song "Goodnight, But Not Goodbye," and so she was cast in the role. While her<ref name="iha" /> lengthy shoot<ref name="Comedy Hour 2" /> was being filmed, Arthur had no inkling that she was participating in anything related to ''[[Star Wars]]''. Ackmena's song has been noted as a high point<ref name="iha" /> of a program that, overall, was universally panned.<ref name="farce1">{{WebCite|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2008-nov-16-ca-starwars16-story.html|text=May the farce be with you (page 1 of 3)|work=[[Wikipedia:Los Angeles Times|''Los Angeles Times'']]|archivedate=20191115073321}}</ref> For ''The Star Wars Holiday Special'', costume designer [[Bob Mackie]] created concept artwork of Ackmena.<ref name="Concept">{{WebCite|url=https://bid.juliensauctions.com/lot-details/index/catalog/381/lot/154370/BEA-ARTHUR-ACKMENA-BOB-MACKIE-COSTUME-ILLUSTRATION-FROM-THE-STAR-WARS-HOLIDAY-SPECIAL|text=BEA ARTHUR "ACKMENA" BOB MACKIE COSTUME ILLUSTRATION FROM THE STAR WARS HOLIDAY SPECIAL|work=[https://bid.juliensauctions.com bid.juliensauctions.com]|archivedate=20240606051925}}</ref>

Author [[Bonnie Burton]] has expressed her affection for Ackmena, citing the character's strength, intelligence, wit, and refusal to take guff from anyone as the driving forces behind her nostalgic love of ''The Star Wars Holiday Special''. When Burton became an administrator of the [[StarWars.com]] forums, she chose a picture of Ackmena as her personal avatar.<ref name="Bonnie's blog">{{OfficialBlog|url=2009/04/25/well-miss-you-ackmena|text=We'll Miss You, Ackmena}}</ref> In an article that Burton wrote concerning hypothetical figures for [[Hasbro]]'s now-defunct ''Unleashed'' line of action figures, Ackmena was one of the characters chosen. [[Pablo Hidalgo]] provided an illustration of the hypothetical Ackmena figure.<ref name="unlweb">{{SWArchive|url=collecting/news/hasbro/f20071205/indexp10.html|text=Checklist: 10 Unlikely Unleashed Figures - Ackmena}}</ref>
